_readme: One entry per piece, in lookbook order. status: 'preview' (no price, 'Ask about this piece'), 'available' (shows price and sizes), 'sold' (moves to the Archive). Set placeholder:false only when the photo shows the real piece. Never write a fiber, origin, or year you have not checked on the garment's label.
